notes: Summary: latency-sensitive market decisioning platform. House-built order-routing service needs sub-50ms p99 inference for re-ranking signals. Very cost sensitive at scale.
Primary ask: evaluate Dedicated for predictable p99 and cost per 1M tokens. Also want Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/caching/quantization trade-offs.
Perf targets: p50 < 10ms, p95 < 30ms, p99 < 50ms for short prompts (~64 tokens); sustained throughput target ~400 req/s with spiky bursts to 1k/s.

Workload details: mix of short chat prompts (agent-facing), reranking for order priority (APIs called inline in critical path), dense embeddings for similarity scoring (batch offline and low-latency on-demand cache hits).
Deployment constraints: VPC-peered Dedicated cluster preferred; temporary public-cloud trial ok for initial perf runs. Must support SSO (SAML) and KMS integration for key management.

Optimization interests: automated batching with latency SLOs, KV/prefix cache to avoid repeated context tokens, 8-bit/4-bit quantization profiles if accuracy drop <1% on eval set, guidance on compilation/kernel selection.
Security & compliance: GDPR-sensitive instruments, need data residency in NA region and audit logs retained 13 months. SOC2 required prior to prod; ISO request later.
Quote from CTO: "We can't trade on models that add jitter — want deterministic fallbacks and clear unit economics."
Commercial: finance asked for 12-month cost forecast comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs self-hosted; want clear break-even tokens/month number.
Demo notes: ran quick hosted demo 2026-02-20, observed p99 ~120ms (hosted), acceptable p50/p95 but p99 spikes unacceptable. Redwood suggested Dedicated + batching/caching changes.
Action items from call 2026-02-27: team to provide 3 canonical prompt templates + 500 eval queries; Redwood to produce initial cost/latency matrix and recommended quant profiles.
POC scope: 2-week Dedicated trial, include perf bench harness, A/B with quantized variants, KV cache enabled vs disabled, trace capture for latency attribution.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (J. Mercer), Head of ML (R. Alvarez), Platform Eng (S. Cho). AE/Maya coordinating SOW and security kickoff.
Notes shorthand: need kernel-level perf notes; ask for SVs on cold start and long-tail tokenization impact; include warmup KV cache recipe.
Linked artifacts referenced during call: Drive perf-bench-reqs.xlsx, FF transcript FF-2026-02-27-9912, Jira INF-4321 for early infra questions.
Sales/Procurement: expect procurement engagement once POC meets p99 target and finance approves cost model. Potential 12–24 month Dedicated contract.
Risk: if Dedicated doesn't hit p99 targets, fallback plan is hybrid: Dedicated for critical rerank path + Hosted for lower-priority tasks. Need gating metrics defined.
